Test these items: Shareable and Tabular profile-required metadata handling, JSON representation uses official field names and round-trips through parser/generator inputs, XML representation support is implemented or explicitly documented as unsupported, canonical URL, version, status, and profile metadata do not break execution, FHIR mapping/profile fields are retained, ignored, or rejected consistently with documented behavior, official examples serialize and parse consistently across supported formats. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.1.0-pre ShareableViewDefinition lines 92-103 and TabularViewDefinition lines 103-104/244-245: ViewDefinition.status is 1..1 and bound to PublicationStatus; supported profile JSON also shows min=1 for ViewDefinition.status.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe fhir4ds-private/docs/prompts/.ai_loop/.temp/qa/sof_vd12_historian_probe.py: parse_view_definition() accepted a ShareableViewDefinition missing status (accepted=True), and validate_view_definition() returned no warning for a direct TabularViewDefinition dataclass missing status. Expected supported Shareable/Tabular profile validation to reject/warn for missing status while preserving valid status execution.
issues.root_cause: validate_supported_view_profiles() activated supported Shareable/Tabular profile constraints, but only checked Shareable url/name/fhirVersion/Column.type and Tabular collection/primitive rules. It did not enforce the inherited required CanonicalResource status cardinality for supported profiles, so strict parser/serializer/generator paths and permissive validation could accept profiled views without status.
issues.resolution: Added shared supported-profile status validation for ShareableViewDefinition and TabularViewDefinition. Strict parse/to_dict/generator paths now reject missing status, and validate_view_definition() warns through the same shared validator. Added focused parser/generator regressions and kept valid profile fixtures status-complete.
